title: Device
description: A network device known to REAP. Some attributes are discovery-managed (read-only via API).

siteId.description: Site that currently owns/reaches this device.

osVersion.description: Operating system / firmware version as discovered (read-only).

role.description: Optional free-form role label for grouping (for example access, core, firewall, wireless-ap).

labels.description: Case-insensitive keys normalized server-side; PATCH overwrites the full map.

featuresEnabled.description: Derived list of device features inferred to be enabled from collected configuration and telemetry.

firstSeenAt.description: Timestamp when the device was first discovered (read-only).

lastSeenAt.description: Most recent time the device was observed/reached (read-only).

runningConfigStatus.description: Latest running configuration status, when available.
